field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF and all six current final JSON files were independently reviewed. Table 1 Dap/YZ462 MIC values reconcile to source cells, but final activity records 32 and 34 assert exact 95% host-survival values from Fig. 9/Fig. 10 captions; those locators only contain 95% confidence-interval text, not 95% survival outcomes. Mouse 90% survival is separately supported at xml:p:59.

Database layer preserves the DBAASP fallback rows as unresolved candidate evidence: authoritative linked article/assay/sequence/literature row counts are all zero, source_verified_count is zero, and no sequence/sequence_length objects remain to fail residue counting. This is acceptable only as not authoritative ingest-ready.

Paper final and packet final contain the same six JSON files and are byte-identical. Current actual counts match review_report counts: 35 activity records, 7 toxicity records, 1 database audit, 7 mechanism claims, and 0 review rework targets. Live rework state has 9 requests, 9 closure receipts, and 0 open tickets, matching analysis_status and materials_manifest.

Mechanism claims keep evidence classes separated: four direct YZ462 mechanism claims, two phenotype-supported YZ462 claims, and daptomycin marked unknown_or_not_tested. Direct claims cite YZ462 membrane/permeability, SEM, and ITC locators; no daptomycin mechanism is promoted from fallback MIC rows.

Paper identity is source-supported by XML/PDF title, DOI 10.1186/s12866-025-04475-6, PMID 41219701, and PMCID PMC12606902. Entity linkage remains cautionary because local authoritative DBAASP/merged rows are absent and the daptomycin fallback candidate has no source-located sequence/modification identity.

Final layer-2 provenance is not publication-grade: accepted 95% survival rows are marked direct from figure captions that do not state those endpoint values, and a locator-index audit found 67 final activity/exclusion locator strings absent from locator_index, mostly xml:table-wrap:1 body-cell coordinates plus the non-index supplement figure=S2 exclusion locator.

No recursive authority promotion was found. Fallback DBAASP/Codex rows remain candidate machine evidence only, source_verified_count is zero, authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, and the strict acceptance artifact explicitly limits the result to paper-level evidence pending release policy approval.

The only preserved current caution is absence of authoritative DBAASP linked rows; no APD6/DRAMP cross-database conflict is present in the local packet. This caution is release-boundary material, not a source conflict resolution failure.

Both staged supplements were inspected. MOESM1 is ASCII tab-delimited text despite .xls extension and is represented as a 458-row table; MOESM2 is a legacy DOC with antiword text, docbook tables, and a recovered ChemDraw CDX OLE text surface. Current packet reports 28 supplementary text rows, 11 tables, and zero unparsed embedded objects.

Accepted toxicity records now preserve source-supported IC50, hemolysis, acute mouse toxicity, body-weight dose groups, and Galleria LD50 values with units and inequalities. Residual caution: the final toxicity_exclusions list still carries a non-index supp:...figure=S2 locator as source_verified even though the accepted body-weight record correctly uses antiword:p=12.

blocking_findings.reason: Final activity_toxicity_evidence.json accepts two exact host-survival records with raw_value 95% and normalization_status direct: $.activity_records[32] for Galleria survival at xml:fig:9 and $.activity_records[34] for mouse survival at xml:fig:10. Independent XML/PDF inspection shows both cited figure captions contain 95% confidence-interval text for log-rank testing, not 95% survival outcomes; xml:p:56 reports improved Galleria survival without an exact scalar, and xml:p:59 separately supports a 90% mouse survival value. These 95% rows are therefore unsupported/conflated exact values and make the current publication_grade PASS invalid.
required_actions: Remove the two unsupported 95% host-survival activity records, or demote them to explicitly approximate/digitized figure observations only if a reproducible figure-digitization artifact and panel/curve locator are supplied.
Do not use 95% confidence-interval text as an endpoint value. Keep the source-supported 90% mouse survival value at xml:p:59 separate from any Fig. 10 graphical observation.
Refresh activity_toxicity_evidence.json in both final mirrors and recompute review_report final_counts after the layer-2 repair.
Reconcile layer-2 locator integrity so accepted records and exclusions use packet-resolvable locators or an explicitly validated table/figure coordinate contract.
acceptance_checks: Executable check: no final activity_records item may have raw_value '95' with source_locator xml:fig:9 or xml:fig:10 unless the cited source text contains a survival outcome value or the record has explicit approximate/digitized provenance with panel and curve coordinates.
Executable check: final activity_records must retain the xml:p:59 90% mouse survival row if still in scope and must not duplicate it with an unsupported Fig. 10 95% row.
Executable check: final_counts in review_report match live final JSON counts after repair and paper/packet final mirrors are byte-identical.

Executable check: a locator audit over all final source_locator/cell_locator fields reports zero unreviewed or unindexed locator strings, or records each as an accepted validated coordinate with exact-vs-approximate status.

cautions.summary: Authoritative DBAASP/merged linked rows are absent; fallback daptomycin rows must remain unresolved candidate evidence and excluded from authoritative ingest.

The current strict acceptance artifact reports publication_grade_pass with zero issues, but independent source review found the unsupported 95% survival scalar defect above; deterministic gate success is not sufficient terminal evidence.
